brief:
Settlers destroyed a main water line in al-Ras al-Ahmar in the Tubas district, according to Shehab Wire. The attack targeted critical infrastructure that supplies water to residents of the community in the northern West Bank.

The destruction of the water line represents the latest incident of infrastructure damage attributed to Israeli settlers in the occupied Palestinian territories. Such attacks have disrupted essential services to Palestinian communities across the West Bank, leaving residents without reliable access to water for household and agricultural use. Repairs to damaged infrastructure often face delays due to security restrictions and limited resources available to local authorities.
